historical.semantic_measure: Stored mean of the three pairwise cosine similarities; configured text-embedding-3-large.
historical.functional_measure: One saved GPT-5.4-pro Boolean for each three-output set.
historical.threshold_diagnostic: All three saved pairwise cosine similarities strictly greater than 0.85. This is a diagnostic, not the stored functional-identity score.

matched216.coverage: Run-1 subset of historical responses; cannot constitute a separate three-run reproducibility study.

corrective162.quality_repeat_variation: Available separately in corrective162/repeat-analysis.json; quality-score ties do not establish semantic or functional identity.

limitations: Stored reproducibility records name task/model/variant but do not contain response hashes or embedding vectors. Current responses match recorded source hashes; these checks do not recover an original server-side request receipt.
Original functional judgments received explicit variant names, task information and outputs in fixed run order. They were not blinded to condition.
One functional judgment per cell and three runs do not estimate judge-repeat uncertainty; three cosine pairs share outputs and are not independent observations.
